hypothesis: A narrow consumer digital platform basket (HOOD, RBLX, SOFI) may add event-sensitive upside that the core A/B universe misses, but prior static tests were unstable. The next valid alpha step is a bounded pilot sleeve activation that collects forward replacement-value evidence without competing for core slots.

related_failed_or_limited_experiments.summary: Consumer digital platform sub-basket was positive but unstable; direct static promotion rejected.
Simple governance gates failed to make the basket robust; forward-governed observation was the valid next step.
Broad event-sensitive liquidity expansion had positive medians but did not beat core average PnL in any fixed window.

historical_context.mechanism_insight_check: This does not repeat rejected threshold, risk multiplier, runner, gap-up, RS20 leader, broad universe, LLM soft-ranking, estimate-revision, or options-quality experiments. It narrows to an already-researched basket and uses the existing pilot sleeve instead of adding noisy core tickers.

why_not_other_alpha: LLM soft-ranking still lacks enough replay or forward decision coverage for a reliable promotion.
Estimate-revision and options-quality alphas currently have forward ledgers but not enough usable outcome rows.
Recent risk add-ons around RS20 leader, gap-up entry state, cluster tails, and runner exits failed Gate 4 or showed concentration risk.
Non-generic event state add-on remains promising but is already waiting on forward report-surface outcomes.
gate_4_assessment: Core fixed-window metrics are intentionally unchanged because the pilot eligibility starts after all canonical windows. This is not accepted as a historical core alpha improvement; it is accepted as a bounded forward alpha activation with PIT safety.
decision_reason: The change creates a low-complexity, production-aligned forward alpha test using an existing shared pilot sleeve. Historical core metrics did not drift, and the basket remains outside core slot competition.
next_review_trigger: Review after 30-60 trading days or enough closed pilot outcomes to compare pilot PnL against the recorded displaced core or cash alternatives.
main_risk: A high-beta consumer platform pilot can consume the single pilot sleeve slot during broad risk-off or event-driven drawdowns, potentially missing a better AI-infra pilot opportunity.
